tagline: Every thalassemia patient deserves phenotype-matched blood.
blood_centers_intro: Register once. Capture grouping, phenotype and antibodies. Share the clinical passport across Blood Centers while keeping stock center-specific.
antigen_hint: Record antigen status where typed. Leave — not tested when not screened; not tested never counts as negative.
confirm_no_rh: No Rh typing for this unit (intentional)
saved_group_changed: Blood group updated from the concordant re-test.
bg_change_body: This concordant re-test gives a final group different from the current anchor:
bg_readonly_hint: The current group changes only via a concordant tube grouping recorded below — it is not edited directly.
ack_pheno: Acknowledge the conflict and record the new value (the existing typing is preserved in the audit trail).
pheno_rule_hint: Blank leaves a value unchanged and never writes negative. A differing typing is flagged, never silently overwritten.
grouping_rule_hint: Saved as a new dated event — never overwrites a prior grouping. A concordant result whose final group differs from the current anchor prompts a blood-group update.
append_hint: Saved as a new dated event — earlier workups are kept.
antibody_permanent: A recorded antibody stays on the record permanently — an evanescent antibody can still trigger an anamnestic response.
ack_dup: Acknowledge: this antibody is already on record; add another dated entry.
